text.p: The following are the top headlines from Uruguayan newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Uruguayan President Julio Sanguinetti said that political dialogue is indispensible to the health of ruling coalition.
- Leaders of National party ask for more effectiveness at the government coalition.
- More obstacles to get a solution in a unions struggle at French firm Gaseba.
- Inter-American Development Bank aims to modernize the Uruguayan banking system.
- Disguised like policemen, thieves robbed half a million dollar.
- Cleaning works to continue in Uruguay after a February oil spill.
